name: fld_eval_eq_zero_forall_iff_dvd
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (f : Polynomial K) : (∀ a : K, Polynomial.eval a f = 0) ↔ (Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card K - Polynomial.X) ∣ f
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (f : Polynomial K), (∀ a : K, Polynomial.eval a f = 0) ↔ (Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card K - Polynomial.X) ∣ f
informal: A polynomial over a finite field F_q vanishes at every point iff it is divisible by X^q - X — X^q - X = ∏_{a} (X - a) (FiniteField.roots_X_pow_card_sub_X, separable with all q roots); the factors X - a are pairwise coprime, so each dividing f gives the product dividing f; the converse is FiniteField.pow_card.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype K] (f : Polynomial K), (∀ (a : K), Polynomial.eval a f = 0) ↔ Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card K - Polynomial.X ∣ f
